title: Expense Report
body:
### Expense Report

Sat, 30 Oct, 2021

[Articles](https://smart-hospital.in/articles)[Reports](https://smart-hospital.in/category/reports)

---

To check Expense report, go to **Reports > Expense** **Report**. Here select the **Time Duration** then click on**Search** button. Here you can see Expense details like **Name, Invoice Number, Expense Head, Date, Amount** etc. Also you can download this report as PDF.
